python -c "
from glom import Auto, Fill, Iter, Invoke, Let, ROOT, T, glom

# Test Auto
print('Auto():', repr(Auto()))
target = {'a': 1}
result = glom(target, Auto())
print('Auto result:', result)

# Test Fill
print('Fill(0):', repr(Fill(0)))
target = {'a': 1}
spec = {'a': 'a', 'b': Fill(0)}
result = glom(target, spec)
print('Fill result:', result)

# Test Iter
print('Iter(T):', repr(Iter(T)))
target = [1, 2, 3]
result = glom(target, Iter(T))
print('Iter result:', result)

# Test Invoke
print('Invoke(\"sum\"):', repr(Invoke('sum')))
target = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
result = glom(target, Invoke(lambda x, y: x + y, args=('a', 'b')))
print('Invoke result:', result)
"
